data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first payment reminder (1. Mahnung) for the annual subscription fee of the "Muster Magazin" (subscription period 1 June 2025 – 31 May 2026), demanding €61.90 (€59.40 outstanding plus a €2.50 reminder fee) by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: This is a first payment reminder (1. Mahnung) from the publisher of your magazine subscription, asking you to pay €61.90 by the stated date. This amount includes the original €59.40 annual fee plus a €2.50 reminder fee for late payment. If you already paid, the letter says to disregard it. If not, transfer the amount to the IBAN given using your subscription number as reference to avoid further reminder fees or possible debt collection. If you believe the charge is wrong, contact the publisher directly, as this letter contains no formal legal remedy instructions.
